answer_raw:
The latest Claude models are **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Claude Mythos 5.2** (undated) [2], while the latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26) [1].

The two families differ primarily in their optimization for specific intelligence domains:

**Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2** — designed for daunting technical work, they offer 30% faster output generation than their 5.1 predecessors and are priced at **$8 per million input tokens** and **$40 per million output tokens** (2026-10-28) [3]. Mythos 5.2 specifically excels in cybersecurity, finding 14.4% more vulnerabilities than Mythos 5.1 (2026-11-02) [5].

**GPT-6.1 Terra** — optimized for fast, capable computer use at scale (2026-10-26) [1]. While it leads in advanced math, science, and native image generation, it lacks the specific technical/security focus of the Mythos class (2026-09-28) [7].

I would use **Claude Fable 5.2** for coding because it was specifically built to set a new bar for coding and technical tasks, with testers noting it handles complex projects and stubborn bugs through improved reasoning and faster output (2026-11-02) [2][5].
